findings.title: Crash on Google Meet fallback when destinationCalendar is empty
findings.body: File packages/core/EventManager.ts line 119 does `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration !== "google_calendar"` where `mainHostDestinationCalendar` comes from `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? []`. When destinationCalendar is null, undefined, or empty array the destructured value is undefined, so accessing `.integration` throws TypeError. Previously `evt.destinationCalendar?.integration` was safe. Any Meet-location booking without a destination calendar will crash event creation instead of falling back to Cal Video.

findings.title: updateEvent fallback can never match, sends undefined calendarId
findings.body: File packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts line 256 computes `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy the else-branch searches for a calendar whose externalId equals that same falsy value, which never matches, so `selectedCalendar` becomes undefined. The subsequent `calendar.events.update({ calendarId: selectedCalendar })` then gets undefined instead of falling back to the destination calendar, causing Google update/reschedule to fail.

findings.title: deleteEvent fallback can never match
findings.body: File packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts line 317 has the same pattern as updateEvent: `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. With no externalCalendarId the find predicate compares against null/undefined and returns undefined, so deletion falls back to "primary" even when a specific destinationCalendar exists, deleting from the wrong calendar or failing to delete the collective host's event.

findings.title: Patch after create omits primary fallback
findings.body: File packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts insert uses `calendarId: selectedCalendar || "primary"` but the follow-up `calendar.events.patch({ calendarId: selectedCalendar })` at line 169 uses the raw value without fallback. When no destination matches the credential, the create succeeds on primary but the patch sends undefined calendarId and fails to add the hangoutLink description.

findings.title: Stale credential reused across calendar references in update
findings.body: File packages/core/EventManager.ts declares `credential` once outside the `for (const reference of calendarReference)` loop and then assigns `credential = this.calendarCredentials.filter(...)[0]` inside. If a later reference's credential is not found in memory and not found in DB, `credential` is not reset to undefined and still holds the previous iteration's credential. The code then calls `updateEvent(credential, ...)` with the wrong user's credential, updating the wrong calendar or crashing on undefined on the first iteration.

findings.title: Inverted IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED condition for org slug
findings.body: File packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts line 151 changed `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` to `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`. The old code stored `slug` when billing was disabled; the new code stores `slug` when billing is enabled and omits it when disabled, the exact opposite. This unrelated change inverts organization creation semantics: direct slug vs requestedSlug handling is swapped, breaking org provisioning.

findings.title: Webhook expectations still assert null destinationCalendar
findings.body: File apps/web/playwright/webhook.e2e.ts line 119 and line 373 still assert `destinationCalendar: null` for BOOKING_CREATED and BOOKING_REQUESTED, while the type changed to `DestinationCalendar[]` and the code now emits `[]` when empty. Only the BOOKING_REJECTED case was updated to `[]`. The two remaining assertions encode the old contract and will fail against the new payload, leaving the webhook API break uncovered.
